contact.sub: If you’ve been charged with a DUI in Montgomery or Bucks County Pa, it’s critical that you hire an experienced and conscientious DUI Defense attorney. Beware, some so-called DUI lawyers will take your money then plead you guilty just to make a quick fee with little effort. You should meet the attorney in his or her office and be sure they will aggressively defend you to minimize the impact the DUI has on your life.
